{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows increasing negativity over recent days.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows strong downward momentum (e.g., 3+ consecutive drops) and sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "If model overestimates prices after a spike (e.g., >15% above recent high), apply a corrective downward bias of 10-20% for the next 3-5 periods.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0) but price is trending downward, apply a mild upward bias to counteract mean reversion.",
    "For long-term forecasts (30-day), reduce forecast volatility if sentiment is stable or mildly positive, to avoid over-optimism.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms model (e.g., 3+ consecutive underperformance), apply a downward correction of 5-15% to next forecast.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is near recent low, consider a slight upward bias to avoid missing rebound potential.",
    "For forecasts with high variance or erratic spikes, apply smoothing filters or reduce confidence in extreme outliers."
  ]
}
